description: Give your home a handsome makeover with the Oxford 5-Tier Bookcase with Drawer. Featuring 5 spacious shelves as well as one drawer for concealed storage you can display books and collectibles while hiding away unsightly accessories. Clean lines paired with the X pattern creates a modern appeal. Crafted with functionality and contemporary styling in mind the Oxford 5 Tier Bookcase with Drawer will become a staple in your home. Also available in multiple finishes this piece will easily complement any home decor. Look for other items from the Oxford Collection for the complete look sold separately.
